question:
In a photoelectric experiment using a fixed photosensitive metal surface, a student records the stopping potential $V_0$ for different incident wavelengths $\lambda$ (all above threshold) and decides to plot a graph of $V_0$ versus $\left(\dfrac{1}{\lambda}\right)$.

(a) Starting from Einstein’s photoelectric equation, derive the linear form of $V_0$ in terms of $\left(\dfrac{1}{\lambda}\right)$.

(b) Hence, state what physical quantity is represented by the slope of the $V_0$ versus $\left(\dfrac{1}{\lambda}\right)$ graph.

(c) Explain how the work function of the metal can be obtained from the intercept of this graph.
